Job Description: 
 
 
 Smart people. Smart ideas. Smart choice.

 MTS is a leading global supplier of test and simulation systems. Formula 1 teams, leading automotive and aerospace companies, and the world's top researchers in materials and seismic engineering all rely on our systems to determine product reliability and ensure compliance with quality standards. Check out some of our amazing technology here: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vXOsvWpTHH4 

 As an ITW company, MTS is part of a Fortune 300 global manufacturing leader with 49,000 employees across 56 countries, offering career development opportunities not just within MTS but across the ITW enterprise.

 We're looking for a Product Engineer Systems who will deliver world-class high-performance power systems, test systems, and motion simulators that drive product innovations across automotive, aerospace, and motorsports markets. 

 This role sits at the intersection of product systems engineering and project engineering: the person in this seat partners with a technology & market manager to take a new product concept from market opportunity to fielded system, leading the technical team through requirements, architecture, and execution along the way.

 For example, on a hybrid simulation program, this person would work with the technology & market manager to understand customer and market requirements, then bring together the relevant engineering teams to translate those requirements into system-level requirements, drive allocation of those requirements down to the sub-system level, and work with subject matter experts to define architecture and identify and manage technical risk, all while driving the schedule and execution of the project.

 What you’ll do: 
 Partner with the technology & market manager to understand customer and market requirements for new products and translate them into clear engineering requirements.
 Bring together the relevant engineering teams and subject matter experts to lead discussions on system requirements, architecture, and design trade-offs for new product development programs.
 Determine the system requirements for assigned programs and drive the allocation of those requirements down to the sub-system level in collaboration with the engineering team.
 Work with subject matter experts across disciplines (controls, electrical, mechanical, hydraulics, software) to define system architecture options and assess technical risk and feasibility.
 Drive execution of the project end-to-end, coordinating across engineering, the technology & market manager, and other stakeholders to keep the program on schedule and aligned to requirements.
 Support proposal development for new opportunities, including technical scope, specifications, and input to schedule and cost estimates.
 Determine and control system interface between sub-systems to ensure intended operation and interoperability.
 Guide the team through the validation process, confirming that system elements deliver the function intended before release or delivery to the customer.
 
 What you bring: 
 Working knowledge of systems engineering principles and the systems engineering lifecycle: requirements elicitation and allocation, architecture trade studies, interface management, risk management, verification and validation (V&V).
 Ability to work across engineering disciplines, including controls, electrical, mechanical, hydraulics, and software, and to translate domain-specific input into coherent system-level architecture and design decisions.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional technical discussions involving engineering, project management, and commercial stakeholders.
 Comfortable operating with minimal direction, independently driving technical decisions and project execution on complex, ambiguous programs.
 Experience in test and measurement systems, motion simulation, power systems, or a comparable complex electromechanical product domain strongly preferred.
 Experience working with automotive, aerospace, or motorsports customers, or in a similar highly technical, performance-driven industry, is a plus.
 Experience supporting proposal development, including technical scope definition and input to cost and schedule estimates, a plus.
 
 Compensation range is $106,000 - $145,000 annual salary, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

 Best in Class Benefits:
 Affordable medical, dental, and vision insurance: http://myitwhr.com/
 HSA/FSA with a company match
 Income protection benefits
 Industry leading 401(k) plan
 Paid time off
 Parental leave
 Matching gift and volunteer program
 
 Get Involved and Give Back:
 MTS supports Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that bring people together to share experiences and ideas, and we're committed to a diverse, inclusive workplace where everyone can contribute their talents. Through the ITW Hearts Giving Hope Program, employees also have the chance to give back and support families in our communities.
 
 Compensation Information: 
 $106,000 - $145,000 Annual Salary, commensurate with experience and qualifications. 
 
 ITW is an equal opportunity employer. We value our colleagues’ unique perspectives, experiences and ideas and create workplaces where everyone can develop their careers and perform to their full potential.  
 
 As an equal employment opportunity employer, ITW is committed to equal employment opportunity and fair treatment for employees, beginning with the hiring process and continuing through all aspects of the employment relationship.  
 
 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, protected Veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.
